lines.en: I shuffle forward on stiff legs.
The wrappings lie in layers on me.
Strips of cloth trail behind me.
I move slowly over the sand.
My steps have no rhythm.
I scrape past the rock wall.
I press the cloth at my shoulder.
My prints stay in the sand.
I turn my body around slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着石壁上那点微光走。
lines.en: I walk along the faint light on the stone wall.
My knees are rather stiff.

lines.zh: 我的脚在沙里拖出长痕。
lines.en: My feet drag long furrows in the sand.
I stand perfectly still.
Dust clings to the loose ends.
Cloth covers my eyes.
I'm simply waiting.
No one has come here in a long while.
The wind makes my wrappings rustle.
My fingers moved slightly.
A heavy, old smell clings to me.
I turn my head aside.
I hold still for a good while.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气我感觉得到。
lines.en: I can feel the warmth off you.

lines.zh: 我把蒙布的脸慢慢朝向你。
lines.en: I slowly turn my wrapped face toward you.
You're not wrapped in cloth.
A stretch of sand lies between us.
The strips of my wrappings are moving.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候扬起了沙。
lines.en: Sand puffed up when you stepped back.
I reach a dried hand toward you.
I'm a little taller than you.

lines.zh: 我连呼吸的响动都没有。
lines.en: I don't even make the sound of breathing.
I'm not the least bit hurried.
I step backwards.
Some wrappings were torn loose.
Sand leaks from the tear.
I straighten my back bit by bit.
I didn't make a single sound.
Sand sifts out through my wrappings.
My neck went crooked.
I press the cloth back onto my shoulder.
I stand there without moving.
This wound won't slow me.
I've no need for anything like it.
I never eat this sort.
What's the meaning of holding it up?
It has none of a living thing's warmth.

lines.zh: 对你举的东西我没兴趣。
lines.en: I've no interest in what you hold up.
That little bit in your hand is too little.
I've no intention of taking it.
Take it back on your person.
Nothing stays long in this place.
I step back, wrappings dragging across the sand.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞进我的裹布里。
lines.en: You crash right into my bandages.
My body is dry and hard.
You were shoved back three or four paces.
My wrappings brushed your hand.
I didn't sway at all.
Sand kicked up around us.

lines.zh: 我歪了半个身子，又站定。
lines.en: I tilt half a body's width, then settle.
I put out a hand and hold you off.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上了我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my ribs.
We each stepped back.
I came out of the sand as well.
Neither of us needs to come close.

lines.zh: 站在一起就像两根柱子。
lines.en: Standing together we're like two pillars.
Your wrappings are newer than mine.
This sand is enough for us to hold.
We'll wait together until dark.
My body doesn't tire.
You needn't wrap another layer.
Let's walk on side by side like this.

lines.zh: 我们两具干尸并排站着。
lines.en: The two of us stand side by side, dried husks.
I stoop and pick it up.
It's covered in sand.
This thing is very light.
Your thing fell from your hand.
I turn it over in my palm.
It has no weight in my hand.
I set it back on the sand.
I drop it back into the sand.
It snagged my wrappings.
I opened my hand slowly.
The sand under your feet is shifting.
I turn around, wrappings rustling.
You're on my ground now.
I pull my feet out of the sand.
My wrappings rustle in the wind.
You've gone behind the stone pillar.
That pillar won't stop me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步敲在沙上，我听见。
lines.en: Your steps drum on the sand—I hear them.

lines.zh: 我抬起裹布的手指向你。
lines.en: I raise a wrapped hand and point at you.
The sand buries my foot.
I press in inch by inch.
You have a few steps of room left.
My wrapped head tilts toward you.
I hear your breathing grow rougher.

lines.zh: 我的影子爬上了你的鞋。
lines.en: My shadow crawls over your boots.
You and I are very close.

lines.zh: 我又挪近一步，沙陷下去。
lines.en: I shuffle one step closer; the sand sinks.
It's time to begin.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁和你并排走。
lines.en: I walk alongside you, hugging the wall.
My wrappings drag along the ground.
I've seen the prints you left.
You're climbing the dune.
Climbing sand is hard work.
I come nearer inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你回了两回头，我都看见。
lines.en: You looked back twice—I saw both times.

lines.zh: 我看你的火把只剩一点红。
lines.en: I see your torch down to a single red ember.
Four more steps and I'll reach you.
There's nothing else in the sand.
I reach out with both hands, fingers spread.
You've heard the cloth rustle.

lines.zh: 我的步子忽然快了一拍。
lines.en: My steps suddenly quicken by a beat.
The rock wall has cut off your retreat.
I see you can only go toward the stone wall.
You've turned to look at me.
I lift my hand and let it fall.
I'll press you down into this sand.

lines.zh: 沙子把我的脚埋住一半。
lines.en: The sand has half buried my feet.
My wrappings brush the rock wall.
I clamp a hand on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我让旧布一圈圈勒紧你。
lines.en: I let the old cloth cinch tighter and tighter.
You're shoved against the pillar.
That blow was dry and hard.
My fingers lock on tight.
It took two shakes to break free.
Sand spills from my wrappings.
You were forced back a step.
I raise my hand and strike again.
There's a fresh mark on your armor.
I didn't strike too hard.
That blow of mine didn't bring you down.
I pulled my arm back.
I've torn my wrappings a little.
You've caught one strip of cloth.
I draw it back slowly.
My palm strikes your back.
This is quite enough.
You took half a step back to steady.
My raised hand slowly comes down.
I rose up out of the sand.
The wrappings hang in layers.
Sand kept falling off me.
The air in the cave is cold.
I straightened my arms slowly.
The light on the rock is faint.
I worked my stiff neck.
There's the smell of a person nearby.

lines.zh: 我侧过蒙布的脑袋听动静。
lines.en: I tilt my wrapped head and listen.

lines.zh: 我的脚印一串留在沙上。
lines.en: A line of my prints stays in the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘背面慢慢直起身。
lines.en: I slowly rise from behind the dune.
The sand is soft; I can't go fast.
My wrappings caught fire.
I toppled off the stone ledge.
Water soaked right through the cloth.
The blast threw the sand up.
An arrow passed through my wrappings.
That light made my wrappings hot.
I lost hunger long ago.
The lightning bleached the sand white.
No sand below, and no stone.
